Florida Gov DeSantis signed CS/CS/HB 919 –Commercial Service Airports.
The bill codifies the names of Florida’s 7 major commercial service airports. The only airport’s name changed is the “Palm Beach International Airport,” which the bill renames as the “President Donald J. Trump International Airport.” This name change is subject to approval by the FAA
